title: PriceHistory
description: Price history of one offer (data/history/<provider>/<tld>.json). Append-only: a new entry only when the price state (currency, VAT mode, unit and the stated amounts) changes, dated with the day the new state was first seen (evidence.fetched_at). The last entry always equals the offer's current state (validate-data). A change of currency, price unit or VAT mode is not continued automatically: the scraper skips the offer and history:sync stops with an error, so a person decides. The history starts with the state at its first entry; there is no older data.

amount.description: Integer minor units (cents) of `currency`, as stated by the provider (offer price); null = unknown.

date.description: Day the state was first seen (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of evidence.fetched_at).

vat_included.description: As in the offer: true gross, false net, null no VAT statement.

source.description: The offer's evidence when the entry was written (nothing fetched for the history).
